name: Entity Reference Deck Paragraphs Library
description: Paragraphs Library companion: library item theme + type presentation decorating the Paragraphs host.
project_description: Feature submodule of Entity Reference Deck. Companion to the Paragraphs host that makes a Paragraphs Library item card reflect the underlying reusable paragraph. Provides LibraryItemCardTypePresentation (decorates the card type presentation), LibraryItemParagraphUnwrapper (resolves the wrapped paragraph), a ParagraphsLibraryItemPreviewProvider, and a library-item Twig template. Depends on the Paragraphs host submodule and the contrib Paragraphs Library module.
